description: Dirty rave hoover riff in A Phrygian at 160 BPM: stab rhythm on power chords, wide detune, drive and grit, ending on a long dive.
Uplifting trance hook in A minor at 138 BPM: one rhythm every bar, a rising call and a falling answer over Am, F, C, G, with offbeat bass underneath.
Slow, wide analog style pad chords, no effects needed.
House organ chord melody at 124 BPM over Am7, Dm7, G7, Cmaj7: one syncopated stab rhythm every bar, a top note melody, the last stab pushing into the next chord, funk bass under it.
Rolling offbeat trance bass on A, F, C and G.
